Manifest.Name: Eleanor Story Expand / 上层区的富家千金爱上在下层区开当铺的我：埃莉诺剧情扩展
Manifest.Author: EleanorRomance Team
Manifest.Description: 1.15 fixes two harem-route presentation bugs: the first line of the second speaker in a two-person scene now uses the companion's name instead of briefly showing the native security-officer label, and Lydia's agreed date now starts as the first scene when the shutter opens, closes the daytime business, then returns the player to the normal evening/after-hours state instead of forcing the next morning. The 1.14 game-version policy, 1.13 mother trade and bail fixes, 1.12 bracelet fix, 1.11 portrait selector and earlier fixes remain. Simplified Chinese / English. 1.15 修复后宫线两处演出问题：双人场景中第二个说话人的第一句不再短暂显示原版“治安官警长”，而是直接使用同伴名字；莉迪亚约定好的约会日现在会在开门时作为首个事件出现，关闭当天营业后把玩家交还给正常的晚上/关店后自由活动，不再强制跳到第二天。保留 1.14 游戏版本策略、1.13 母亲交易与保释修复、1.12 手镯修复、1.11 立绘选择及更早修复。简体中文 / English。
